claims.text: A boy at the time of the War of the Ring, he accompanied Pippin Took when he first arrived in the city of Minas Tirith. He led Pippin to the Great Gate of Minas Tirith to view the men from the various provinces of Gondor coming to Pelennor to reinforce the city against the impending siege.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "Minas Tirith", p. 769

claims.text: Bergil served the Houses of Healing during the Battle of the Pelennor Fields. He found athelas for Aragorn, which was used to heal Faramir, Éowyn, and Meriadoc.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "The Houses of Healing", p.859; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "The Houses of Healing", p. 865
